hints.title: Subsequence Sum Bit Contribution
hints.text: Every prefix sum is an achievable subsequence sum.

hints.title: Bitwise OR across Cumulative Sums
hints.text: Accumulating running prefix sums captures all bit carries generated by subsets.

hints.title: Cumulative Bit Union
hints.text: Taking the bitwise OR of all individual numbers together with all running prefix sums covers all possible bits that can be turned on.
